premises.text: Huge volumes of uploaded and produced video all need music
premises.evidence_span: 400 hours of video is uploaded to YouTube every single minute

premises.text: Stock audio is slow to search, expensive, rights-confusing, poorly fitting, and non-unique
premises.evidence_span: spent ages searching for the right track. When he's finally found one he likes, it's expensive, costing around $40 for a three-minute track. The copyright and royalties are really confusing. And it won't fit his video

premises.text: AI software writes original music from scratch using music-theory and machine-learning rules and auto-produces it to a professional standard
premises.evidence_span: patent-pending software that writes original music completely on its own

premises.text: The system yields unlimited unique royalty-free tracks that are instantly customizable and much cheaper
premises.evidence_span: create an unlimited amount of unique music in a variety of styles that's completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper than the alternatives

premises.text: Users get five free tracks monthly then pay about $7 per additional track at download
premises.evidence_span: You get five free tracks every month and then pay around $7 for an additional track

premises.text: Technology can also be licensed to platforms that supply music to their users
premises.evidence_span: we'll also license our technology to companies that themselves want to provide music to their users, such as YouTube itself, Twitch, Instagram, Vime, you name it

value.text: Original, customizable, royalty-free music for video creators at much lower cost
value.evidence_span: unlimited amount of unique music in a variety of styles that's completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper

causal_links.evidence_span: writes original music completely on its own
about 80% cheaper than what you'd pay elsewhere

notes: v1.3.1 §4.1.1: patent-pending attached to the AI composer mechanism, not a separate premise. Traction (Google, Royal Family, track counts) excluded. Price and B2B licensing kept together as commercial domain but as two premises because licensing could fail while consumer pricing stands.
